_doc: Mission file (openspec/changes/mission-scripting; the format is docs/design/mission-files.md). Edit with tools/mission-editor or by hand.
name: Freighter escort
objective: See the {ship} safely through this sector.
brief: The {name(freighter_fac)} freighter {ship} shares this sector with you, and raiders have her on their scopes. Stay with her until they are driven off.

objectives.text: Keep the {ship} alive and drive off the raiders
Bring her through with half her hull

result.log: The {ship} went on her way under your guns.
The {ship} was lost on your watch.
